Package com.datastax.driver.core

Class PerHostPercentileTracker

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.datastax.driver.core.PercentileTracker
      • com.datastax.driver.core.PerHostPercentileTracker
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    LatencyTracker
    public class PerHostPercentileTracker
extends PercentileTracker
    A PercentileTracker that maintains a separate histogram for each host.

    This gives you per-host latency percentiles, meaning that each host will only be compared to itself.

    • Method Detail

      • computeKey

        protected Host computeKey​(Host host,
                          Statement statement,
                          Exception exception)
        Description copied from class: PercentileTracker
        Computes a key used to categorize measurements. Measurements with the same key will be recorded in the same histogram.

        It's recommended to keep the number of distinct keys low, in order to limit the memory footprint of the histograms.

        Specified by:
        computeKey in class PercentileTracker
        Parameters:
        host - the host that was queried.
        statement - the statement that was executed.
        exception - if the query failed, the corresponding exception.
        Returns:
        the key.

      • builder

        public static PerHostPercentileTracker.Builder builder​(long highestTrackableLatencyMillis)
        Returns a builder to create a new instance.
        Parameters:
        highestTrackableLatencyMillis - the highest expected latency. If a higher value is reported, it will be ignored and a warning will be logged. A good rule of thumb is to set it slightly higher than SocketOptions.getReadTimeoutMillis().
        Returns:
        the builder.
